requirements.text: Up to THREE concurrent build loops are AUTHORIZED (this is the new owner decision that D-071-R001 required before any third loop). Every loop, including a third instance, runs under the full D-071 isolation regime unchanged: its own supervisor runtime identity (a distinct --checkout deriving its own lock, journal, and audit chain), its own task worktree and branch, and a packet whose allowed_paths are DISJOINT from every other live loop packet. Integration stays sequential: the orchestrator merges each loop's finished work one at a time at seams (ADR-005 unchanged). Lane selection for any loop must come from released, non-held work; the expansion/3D hold is untouched.
requirements.required_harness: Any third supervisor instance stands up with its own lock/journal/audit chain and launcher; the pre-launch overlap check covers ALL live loop packets; loops run concurrently without cross-writes.
requirements.required_evidence: launcher + runtime state dirs per instance; G0 report overlap statement in each loop packet
requirements.status_reason: Captured before acting; no third instance exists yet.

requirements.text: Keep two, and when eligible work allows three, loops running side by side for throughput (owner: "make sure 2 or even 3 loops are running side by side so we get more done"). The orchestrator contracts enough disjoint-scope packets from released, non-held work to feed the running loops, and records the concrete reason whenever fewer than two loops are running (no eligible disjoint work, sustained machine/account contention, breaker stop awaiting owner decision, owner hold, or seam work in progress).
requirements.required_harness: At the next loop relaunch seam, two or more loops are launched on disjoint contracted packets (or the shortfall reason is recorded in the session record/handoff).
requirements.required_evidence: launcher ACTIVE-TASK blocks with fresh run-ids per instance; the contracted packet files; handoff/session record naming the loop count and any shortfall reason
requirements.status_reason: Captured before acting; both loops are down at clean stops pending the M5-T035 harvest seam.

requirements.text: No conflict between loops (owner: "make sure there is no confilig bettwen the loops"): before ANY loop launch the orchestrator verifies zero allowed_paths overlap across ALL live loop packets (pairwise, not just against one peer) and records the check; no two loops ever share a worktree, branch, or supervisor runtime identity; the orchestrator alone integrates, sequentially at seams. On an observed cross-write, scope collision, or sustained machine/account contention, reduce the loop count stepwise (3 to 2 to 1) — D-071's drop-on-contention rule stands and now applies at each step.
requirements.required_harness: Pairwise allowed_paths overlap check across all live loop packets recorded before each launch; post-run integration confirms zero cross-writes.
requirements.required_evidence: overlap-check record (G0 report or session/seam record) per launch wave; integration seam commits showing disjoint file sets
